title: Reject non-drive extended Windows paths in cleanup-report retention containment
outcome: The read-only cleanup report rejects or leaves non-matching Windows namespace spellings whose extended prefix is not followed by a drive-absolute path, rather than resolving them relative to cwd.
acceptance: Retention validation rejects non-drive extended namespace forms including \\?\Volume{...}, \\?\GLOBALROOT and corresponding //?/ spellings, while supported drive-absolute forms and ordinary repository-relative paths retain their documented meaning.
Focused regression tests cover these forms and show that they cannot create a repository-contained retention solely because the report runs inside the checkout.
